create_iCIFAR10_dataset: create an incremental CIFAR10 dataset with task-specific classes, memory replay, and discriminator labels
create_iCIFAR100_dataset: create an incremental CIFAR100 dataset subclass with fine-grained labels and task-based filtering
create_DatasetGen: create a DatasetGen object that manages CIFAR100 task splits, dataloaders, and experience replay memory
get_task_dataloaders: get train, validation, and test dataloaders for a specific task ID from DatasetGen
update_task_memory: update the experience replay memory by sampling random samples per class for a given task
